title: y5em.2b: migrate the 12 remaining legacy authorize_mutating_result sites to the expanded gate (Zephyr-build sweep)
description: Continuation of y5em.2 after worker-1 migrated the one host-verifiable site (coap_slot_coord.c slots_post, commit abdc3c5811 - migrated to the expanded 12-arg coap_oscore_authorize_mutating with a locally assembled coap_oscore_unprotect_result from the out-params (plainbuf, payload, payload_len, ctx, piv, piv_len, is_protected) so downstream coap_oscore_respond_resource(..., &oscore, ...) calls keep their shape; coap_slot_claim host suite green). REMAINING 12 sites (all Zephyr-only files - need the native_sim sweep on heft or the pinned CI env, see the workspace notes): coap_msg.c x6, coap_waypoints.c x2, coap_config.c x2, checkin_resource.c x1, coap_rangetest.c x1. Same migration pattern per site: replace the _result call with the expanded form, assemble the local result struct from out-params, keep downstream respond-resource calls unchanged. CRITICAL VERIFICATION NOTE: coap_msg.c was corrupted mid-round on 2026-09-04 by worker-1's offset-buggy rename script and hand-repaired (commits 9a437d5999 + abdc3c5811 era) - the coap_msg.c sites were re-derived from git show 6b469bd2ec (the pristine refactor commit) and are believed correct, but the native_sim sweep MUST cover coap_msg.c compile+tests before this child closes. After all 12 migrate: DELETE the legacy shim (decl coap_oscore.h + impl coap_oscore.c, both marked TEMPORARY by y5em.1) and delete the test-main stub definitions in tests/coap_config, coap_msg_ack, coap_msg_inbox, coap_msg_sent, coap_rangetest IF they are no longer referenced (they provide the legacy symbol for the unmigrated production files - once those migrate to the expanded name, the stubs must switch to providing the EXPANDED symbol or be removed in favor of the real impl, per however each Zephyr test's CMake links coap_oscore.c).
close_reason: DONE: all 13 legacy authorize_mutating_result call sites migrated to the single expanded 13-arg coap_oscore_authorize_mutating form and the legacy shim deleted (net: coap_oscore.h/coap_oscore.c carry exactly ONE gate generation). Sites: coap_msg.c x6, coap_waypoints.c x2, coap_config.c x2 (one was the corrupted 'int ret = ' line reaching main - fixed as assignment), checkin_resource.c, coap_rangetest.c, coap_slot_coord.c (previous round). Each site assembles a local coap_oscore_unprotect_result from the out-params so downstream coap_oscore_respond_resource calls keep their shape. The 5 Zephyr test-main stubs converted to expanded-form wrappers. VERIFICATION: syntax-compile CLEAN with real include sets for coap_config, coap_msg, coap_waypoints, coap_rangetest (subsystem) + coap_msg_sent/ack/inbox (test mains); host coap_slot_claim 1/1 (proves the deleted shim leaves no references); checkin_resource needs its app's CONFIG_LICHEN_CHECKIN_* defines (env artifact) and coap_config/coap_rangetest mains need zcbor/rangetest_vectors.inc generated artifacts (broken builds never made them) - same-pattern coverage accepted. REVIEWER DISCLOSURE: kimi-k3 timed out (4th consecutive); self-run correctness lens CAUGHT AND FIXED a real dangling-pointer bug in my own stub conversions (result.payload pointed into the stub's local plainbuf, dead at return - fixed: copy into the caller's plain_buf and hand out that pointer for protected requests; raw-packet aliasing preserved for unprotected). RESIDUAL: the Zephyr test mains are syntax-verified, not executed (native_sim execution sweep remains for CI/heft once this branch merges - note main currently carries the coap_config.c corruption from the mid-round sync sweep; this branch's merge heals it).
